title: Evidence-exchange core: typed record envelopes, bounded packs, witnesses and closure components
outcome: Evidence-exchange core: typed record envelopes, bounded packs, witnesses and closure components
acceptance: Typed record envelopes with a closed kind-dispatched decoder reproduce each original canonical record's exact RFC 8785 bytes, including the absent-versus-null distinction, and refuse an unknown kind by name.

Immutable evidence packs enforce the accepted bounds (record 8 MiB; pack 16 MiB and 4096 envelopes; component 64 MiB and 8192 objects; batch 64 MiB; staging 256 MiB) with typed oversize outcomes and never truncate.
Origin-feed segment/cut witnesses and governing-snapshot witnesses follow the accepted design (w-09c87a312e95 notes 7a94378a and 31a28eee) with collision, gap and continuity outcomes.
Dependency closure partitions records into atomic components (an indivisible SCC; acyclic predecessors importable first) with no half component exposed.
Behavior tests from the design's §10 cases cover the above. No transport, ledger wiring or destination credit is part of this item; those stay on w-7413b4728667.
